undocumented.title: F12 terminates program with *INLR=*ON rather than a simple return
undocumented.code_does: When F12 is pressed, the employees program sets *INLR = *ON before returning, which fully closes the program and releases all resources rather than leaving it dormant in the call stack.
undocumented.why_it_matters: If the program were ever called from a context that expects to re-activate a dormant activation group, *INLR=*ON would cause loss of any retained state; no specification rule addresses this lifecycle behaviour.

undocumented.title: Employee List screen displays total department salaries (XTOT) in the subfile control
undocumented.code_does: The program fetches total salary data via getDeptDetail() and writes it to the XTOT field displayed in the subfile control header before entering the main interaction loop.
undocumented.why_it_matters: No specification rule in the assigned cluster (or referenced in BR-018) describes the presence of an aggregate salary total on the Employee List screen.
